gloss: quitting salaried work to go independent; leaving company employment

definitions.gloss: quitting salaried work to go independent; leaving company employment
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving a stable salaried job at a company to start one's own business or become self-employed. A blend of 脱 (escape from) and サラ (short for サラリーマン).

examples.japanese: {脱サラ|だつさら}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: I quit my salaried job and opened a café.

examples.japanese: {脱サラ|だつさら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{夢見|ゆめみ}ている→夢見る：10543_yumemiru⟧⟦サラリーマン→サラリーマン：06084_sarariiman⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many salaried workers dream of quitting to start their own business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大手企業|おおてきぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}めて{脱サラ|だつさら}し、⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: He quit a major company, left salaried work behind, and started farming.

notes:
A compound abbreviation combining 脱 (escape, shed) and サラ (short for ⟦サラリーマン→サラリーマン：06084_sarariiman⟧, salaryman). Also used as a suru-verb: 脱サラ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to quit salaried employment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱サラ|だつさら}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to quit salaried employment
- {脱サラ|だつさら}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧起業⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to quit and start a business
- {脱サラ|だつさら}⟦{組|くみ}→組：02668_kumi⟧: people who have quit salaried work
- {脱サラ|だつさら}⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧: former salaryman turned farmer
